q: What is the embodied carbon of a glass facade per square metre?
title: Glass facade embodied carbon per sq m
short: Add the glass, usually double glazed units, and the aluminium frames and brackets. Aluminium often decides the result. Multiply each by its weight per square metre and a named factor, or use the supplier's EPD. Operational savings from better glazing are a separate figure.

ul: Glass kg × float glass factor, plus coating and lamination.

p: Aluminium frames and profiles exported to the EU can fall under CBAM; check the CN code.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
